scenarios.causalMutation: Duplicate a row id in the review package selection matrix.
Inject a fake family, seed or package row not present in Goal 060/059.

diagnostics.message: Row must be one of the accepted matrix rows.

scenarios.causalMutation: Add a marker to the report without running the Unity/player route.

diagnostics.message: Player markers must come from the Unity Alpha logs.

scenarios.causalMutation: Replace a package file with malformed JSON.
Remove a family media binding required by the package row.

diagnostics.message: Every package row needs its family media bindings.

scenarios.causalMutation: Delete a package file referenced by Goal 060 inventory.
Drop package/media provenance from the RC manifest.

diagnostics.message: Every row and binding must keep review trace.

scenarios.causalMutation: Emit package rows in filesystem enumeration order instead of family/seed order.

diagnostics.message: Rows must be deterministically family/seed ordered.

scenarios.causalMutation: Claim provider/LLM/RAG/media generation in a review package script.

diagnostics.message: Provider, LLM, RAG and media generation are forbidden.

scenarios.causalMutation: Claim Runtime or public GamePackage schema mutation as proof.

diagnostics.message: Runtime and GamePackage schema broad mutation are forbidden.

scenarios.causalMutation: Reference an executable path outside the review package root.
Change a Goal 054 media file after Goal 055 recorded its hash.

diagnostics.message: Media hash must match source proof.

scenarios.causalMutation: Change one physical Goal 060 package after inventory hashes were recorded.
Mutate Unity outside the narrow bootstrap marker route.

diagnostics.message: Unity changes are limited to AlphaRuntimeBootstrap markers.

scenarios.causalMutation: Point a package or script outside the review package root with ../ traversal.

diagnostics.message: Paths must be traversal-free repo-relative paths.
